verdict.rationale: Fastmail documents JMAP (open standard, autodiscovery, OAuth/Bearer auth) and offers API tokens/app passwords for IMAP/SMTP access, plus explicit import/export tooling for switching, and runtime probes confirm the JMAP endpoint and autodiscovery work live; community reports corroborate SMTP/IMAP-style fetch-from-Gmail use and easy migration. Missing for 10: no first-party docs explicitly enumerating a full mbox/eml bulk-export tool or IMAP-specific docs page, and independent confirmation of full standards-based export beyond migration/import tooling.
